Naked: Well-toned and muscular physique, showing signs of a warrior's training.
Several small scars across her torso and limbs, not severe but indicative of past battles.
Story: Born into a family of warriors, Astrid was raised on tales of valor and battle. She trained from a young age, proving herself more than capable with an axe and shield.
Her first major battle left her with a distinctive scar, but also solidified her reputation as 'Stormheart', a warrior who charged into the fray with unyielding ferocity.
She joined the crew of the 'Sea Serpent' seeking adventure and the thrill of battle, quickly earning her place among the seasoned shieldmaidens.
Residence: Longship 'Sea Serpent' (at sea, or various Nordic settlements)
